scope: Eight recovery controls and managed failover, PITR, reconnect, static activation, rollback, replay, environment, and state drills

evidence: All eight plan-required recovery controls are explicit, audited, and linked to a runbook
Drill matrix records provisional RPO at most five minutes, RTO at most thirty minutes, and generation rollback at most fifteen minutes
